name: 57252 · Milbank, SD
findings: ZIP 57252 (Milbank) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57252 (Milbank) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 57252 (Milbank) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
